comparison: comparison.json contains exact whitespace-normalized occurrence checks for nine material clauses in the historical MHLW PDF and the later R8.4 PDF. These checks prove those quoted clauses match at the two observed endpoints, not uninterrupted effectiveness between them.

newEvidence.result: 100% net-wage threshold is subject to the voluntary-move/low-wage-area exception; same material sentences appear in later R8.4 pp.80-81.
Lawful yet unreasonably inferior non-wage conditions versus same work in the area are a legitimate-refusal category; same material sentence appears in later R8.4 p.82.
Even after two months of nonpayment, certain timely future payment defeats the legitimate-refusal reason; same material sentence appears in later R8.4 p.82.

questions.limitedCompletionProposal: Historical and later MHLW editions agree in the tested material sentences for A-E. E still requires care because the stem says a union filed, whereas 53251(1)ロ speaks of the person or employer filing; the stem's 'if other conditions are met' can include the worker's confirmation request. The dated Labor Union Act establishes the underlying unlawful dismissal and remedy procedure, but does not itself decide unemployment-benefit eligibility. Obtain a dated edition or contemporaneous official instruction before final closure.

newEvidence.result: An agreement to continue employment without wages does not relax benefit eligibility; material sentence also in later R8.4 p.16.
Retroactive wage payment under provisional order triggers cancellation/benefit return; material sentence also in later R8.4 pp.11-12.
Where closure makes restoration impossible, qualification-loss confirmation need not be rescinded; material sentence also in later R8.4 p.10.
When earnings in subsequent employment equal/exceed offset wages, worker may choose one insured relationship; material sentence also in later R8.4 p.11.

Provisional benefits are authorized for qualifying contested dismissal. The manual does not say that union filing alone replaces the worker's benefit confirmation request; the stem conditions benefits on the other requirements. Labor Union Act 7(1),27(1) is fixed as of 2025-04-11 in labor-union-act-asof20250411.json.

newEvidence.result: Requires appointing authority permission for remunerated private work; says nothing about unemployment-insurance status.
Government employment is excluded only when specified severance/benefit conditions and ministerial-rule criteria hold; public-employee status by itself is insufficient.
